name: humanish-tokens
title: humanish tokens
description: The humanish.dev token system: paper/ink mineral palette, ultramarine accent, dark-zone tokens, shadows, and type stacks. Light by default; dark via prefers-color-scheme or data-theme="dark" on <html>. Import the stylesheet in your global CSS.
docs: Import in your global stylesheet: @import "../styles/humanish/humanish-tokens.css"; — tokens are plain CSS custom properties on :root (plus a Tailwind v4 @theme block), so they work with or without Tailwind. Wire --font-newsreader / --font-geist / --font-geist-mono (e.g. via next/font) or the type stacks fall back to system faces.
